steps.content:
I want to fly one more time.
Til we meet again.

Zephyr

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Any sign of her?

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: All Sinner-authorized areas have been checked. We didn't find the target.

steps.speaker: Staff B
steps.content: Chief! The tech team is working at full throttle to resolve the signal interference. So far, there's no sign of Sinner Zephyr in the restored surveillance zones.
Due to malicious signal interference, the Bureau has automatically activated its defense protocols. Security lasers scan the corridors as defense weapons stand ready to engage any suspicious targets.
You rush through the security measures with your clearance, trying to sense the Sinner's location through your shackles while issuing commands.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Target is still nearby. Expand search radius and keep looking for her. Avoid armed conflict unless absolutely necessary. Report any findings immediately!

steps.speaker: Staff Members A & B
steps.content: Copy that... Chi—
Still unstable, the recently restored communications signal suddenly cuts out.

Just as you lower your hand, the terminal—which should have lost all signal—suddenly buzzes with a message. As you feel the device vibrate in your hand, your heart skips a beat as if sensing a harbinger of things to come.

Zephyr: Hey, I promised to take you flying with me, but looks like that plan's a no-go. MBCC won't let us do this, so I'm going on my own.

Zephyr: Besides, this old bird might be a bit dangerous to fly. I'll take you up when it's safer next time.

Zephyr: Don't worry about me, but feel free to miss me a bit.
The notice of no signal pops up. You fail to send out the message.

Just like what she did before, Zephyr has hijacked the communication, denying you any chance to reach her. As you stare at the red exclamation mark on the terminal screen, your anxiety continues to mount.

You can't simply let a Sinner escape. Apart from the consequences she will inevitably face, the prevailing weather conditions and her physical condition make it impossible to ensure her safety during the flight. You can't stand by and watch Zephyr put herself in danger.
You carefully recall her messages, considering where she might have gone. Finally, all the details point to one location.
Near MBCC, at the decommissioned aircraft salvage yard, the orange-haired figure you've been desperately searching for stands beside the only old aircraft that hasn't been dismantled yet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Zephyr!
Zephyr has just opened the cockpit and settled into the pilot's seat. Upon spotting you, she offers you a casual wave.
Under her operation, the engine emits a piercing screech as the fuselage violently shudders, threatening to fall apart at any moment.

Yet she remains oblivious to all these dangers. With her hand on the control yoke, Zephyr could take off at any second. You keep your voice gentle to lower her guard while looking for an opportunity to approach the cockpit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hurry and come down, Zephyr. Echo and Mess are looking for you tonight—being all secretive like they're planning something behind my back.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You arranged all that, didn't you, Chief?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You told everyone to have me involved while having fun. And when things got a little wild at the Bureau, you kind of just turned a blind eye, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: The Bureau really is more interesting than I thought. I even scored some missions outside every now and then. Turns out, this place isn't half as uptight as I imagined.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: There was also one time that I saw... they erased a record of me coming back late from a mission.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Thank you for trying to make things easier for me, even as a supervisor.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's really not that difficult. If there's something you want to do, just tell me. We can make it without breaking the rules.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We can figure it out, together.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: It's precisely because there's so much freedom here, and because you, Chief, try so hard to make life comfortable for us Sinners... that I've realized I'm more greedy than I thought.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Change and adaptation take time. Many Sinners felt the same way when they first came to the Bureau.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Zephyr, you don't need to rush to any conclusions about yourself. We can take things one step at a time...

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: But that's not enough. What I want is more than that.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You know what? I'm really craving a pineapple bun today.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What?
Such a random statement catches you off guard. Your brain works intensively processing it, only to produce a questioning sound.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I got up at seven in the morning and waited forever until afternoon tea time, only to find out the cafeteria suddenly stopped making pineapple buns today.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: So I borrowed the kitchen from Kelvin, thinking I could whip up some myself if I tried hard enough. But I had a dispatch mission in the afternoon, which left me only an hour to work with.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Then I thought I could just buy some instead... but by the time I finished my mission, the bakery had sold out of pineapple buns.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Coming out of the bakery, I thought to myself: the old me would've turned Eastside upside down just to get my hands on a pineapple bun today.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: But back then, my first thought was actually: other bakeries are too far away, and there's not enough time left, so maybe I'll just let it go.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: My ambitions have shrunk smaller than a pineapple bun.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We can discuss all your wishes. MBCC has handled tougher situations before. As long as the requests are reasonable, I'm sure we can figure out a way to make it happen...

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: That's exactly what I hate!
Zephyr cuts you off mid-sentence, her voice charged with emotion.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Ever since becoming a Sinner, I need to file paperwork just to get to talk, just to see someone who can help me. Then everything I want to do gets numbered and sorted by priority and urgency.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Even with you, Chief, even the most empathetic person towards Sinners in the entire Bureau, our peak of mutual understanding was probably just that talk in the interrogation room. After that, everything I've wanted to do has to come after a "request form."

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Once my past and crimes were understood and documented, it felt like my story was archived and shelved away. Any greater adventures that might come after... they probably will no longer have anything to do with me.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Sinner Zephyr may have found a bit of freedom in MBCC, but what about I, Zephyr, myself and my own life after this? Will I ever get to see wider skies again?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Is there any chance for more interesting stories to unfold in my life?

She tilts her head back slightly, as if releasing all the questions that have built up during her time at the Bureau. Yet she doesn't seem to be throwing them at you for answers—it's more like she's thinking aloud to herself.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: The freedom I want isn't just having permission to do things once or twice in a never-changing life—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then can you tell me what it is that you want? Do you have an answer now?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I don't...

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: ...But I know I'll never be able to find out by looking up from down here.
Her expression remains unchanged as she speaks, but you keenly sense a subtle shift within her.
The situation is spiraling out of control. You rush toward the cockpit, your voice rising involuntarily.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Zephyr, don't risk your life for this!

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: If I could just fly above the clouds one more time, I know I'd finally understand what I truly want.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: It won't affect anyone else this time! Besides, this plane is headed for the scrapyard anyway, right? I've done my research.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I just checked, and the good news is this model's only showing age-related wear, nothing severely damaged.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: The bad news is there's barely any fuel left, the autopilot's locked up, the engine's making weird noises, the frame's a bit shaky, the instruments are off, and even the control yoke gets stuck when I try to pull it back...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you have any idea what could happen if you try to fly it in this condition?!

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: This means I can only guarantee it'll make it up into the sky. What happens next, though? Your guess is as good as mine.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: If luck's on my side, I'll touch down safely after sunrise.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: And if I'm not so lucky, well, I suppose I'll be free up there in the sky.
She speaks of death as casually as if discussing tomorrow's weather, the words flowing from her lips like any other trivial matter.
In that split second of your distraction, Zephyr gives you a playful wink and decisively slams her palm down on the engine start button.
Your body moves before your mind can catch up. You leap into the cockpit and grab Zephyr's wrist just before she can pull the control yoke.
But the engine has already sprung to life, the power gauge on the dashboard steadily rising as the aged propellers start to thunder, signaling the imminent departure.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Wha—Why do you come up here?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop, Zephyr! This plane is in no condition to fly. It's too dangerous!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're getting off with me.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I'm not!
The propellers spin faster and faster. You have no time left.

Crimson thorns pierce through Zephyr's body. With the neural interference of her powers blocked, you know the pain in her injured leg will be magnified intensely—but to stop her from doing something even more reckless, you are left with no choice.
Restrained by your shackles, her movements become visibly labored. Fine beads of sweat form on her forehead as she fights to suppress what must be excruciating pain.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: No matter what, I MUST fly!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...The shackles have sealed your power. Without your signal interference ability, you can't maintain the autopilot system. You'd have to fly manually.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This isn't the time to act all tough, Zephyr. Taking off in the rain with an injured leg and uncontrollable pain—you will die.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: So what?
In the pilot's seat, her steel-plated leg lies rigid and unmoving. Her face has turned deathly pale from the pain, yet it only makes her determined gaze ahead burn all the brighter.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: So what if it's bad weather? So what if I lost my power? What difference does it make?!

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Sinner or not, I'm Zephyr—the greatest pilot there is!
As the plane accelerates towards takeoff speed, the nose cone starts to rise. However, halfway through the ascent, the power abruptly cuts out, causing the aircraft to plummet downwards.
The landing gear crashes against the ground, dragging with an ear-splitting screech of metal.
Amidst violent turbulence, Zephyr grits her teeth, but the pain drains the strength from her arms, rendering her completely unable to move the rusted control yoke.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Jump! Now! There's still time!
Zephyr's sweat-soaked orange hair clings to her forehead as she valiantly battles through the excruciating pain, still finding the breath to urge you to evacuate the aircraft.
Even though the plane remains grounded, she gazes ahead with unwavering determination, as if already beholding the view of her dreams, her eyes devoid of any hint of hesitation.
You steel your resolve and take Zephyr's hand. After exchanging a resolute look, you grip the control yoke with both hands, helping her pull.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Messing with death? Oh, trust me—I've got way more practice with that than you do.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...All this fuss just to look cool, seriously?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now I'm not going to let you get away without showing me these skies you dream of.
Zephyr freezes for a moment, then her demeanor changes, becoming once again that vibrant soul you first met at the bar.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You asked for it... Now get ready to see what I'm really capable of!
As the plane suddenly accelerates in a straight line, the overpowering gravity pull slams you back, prompting you to clutch Zephyr's hand tighter. Yet you give her a firm nod.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Now... Welcome to Zephyr's territory!

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Dear honored first passenger, our aircraft is about to take off and will be passing through the nimbostratus cloud in just a few minutes. If you're feeling a bit nervous, just close your eyes—zoom, and we'll zip right through it!
The deafening roar of the engines grows more violent. Inside the cockpit, Zephyr's gaze remains locked dead ahead, her hands navigating the controls without a moment's hesitation.

After one last shudder, the aircraft's nose abruptly points up at an unthinkable angle. The city's silhouette shrinks rapidly below while the aging plane strains against the fierce winds, its structure groaning as if on the verge of crumbling apart.
Your eardrums throb with painful pressure. You squeeze your eyes shut, feeling the extraordinary turbulence rattle your body as you instinctively hold your breath.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: We did it! We made it, Chief! Look!
After what seems like an eternity, the aircraft finally steadies itself. As your companion's exclamation pierces through the air, you slowly open your eyes...

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: DisCity is really huge—we're way high up and still can't see where it ends. I was hoping to catch a glimpse of the Outlands from here at least.
The aircraft hovers at DisCity's peak. Beneath you, the entire city rests suspended between sleep and wakefulness in the pre-dawn blue, both precious and fragile.
This view of DisCity is new to you—your previous flights were all combat missions during tumultuous times.
This city now seems unusually peaceful... stretching endlessly onward, brimming with infinite possibilities.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, how's it? How do you like it? I was so hyped the first time I flew up here and caught this view!
Beyond her excitement, there's a barely perceptible trace of nervousness in Zephyr's voice as she gauges your reaction...
You try to understand Zephyr.
Within the layer of clouds, a sea of ever-changing white envelops both of you. The emerging dawn and fading moonlight blend together, their boundaries dissolving into one.
As the clouds disperse, a faint ribbon of light unfurls between the city and the sky. You and Zephyr track its course through the air, and at this moment, the world becomes vivid and tangible.
When you open your eyes and look down, DisCity is right beneath your feet, slowly stirring to life as the slanting morning light bathes it in warmth.

options: The view up here is so different from what I'm used to.

choices.text: The view up here is so different from what I'm used to.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Right?!

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Gorgeous, isn't it?!

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Actually, ${PlayerName}, I was a bit worried earlier... If you found the view here lame, you might think all those days I spent breaking out weren't worth it...

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You're my first ever passenger, and in a way, this is my first official flight as a pilot. I really wanted us to experience this happiness together.
At this moment, your own encounter intertwines with a memory of Zephyr's past. Now you truly understand who Zephyr is and what she wants.
Understand her devotion to the boundless sky, and her yearning for freedom that runs bone-deep.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: That day, when my parents and I left home, it was pouring rain. But as we drove on and on, it felt like we were leaving the bad weather behind us.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: We drove far enough that all those little arguments from before we left just melted away. By the end, my moms were just marveling at how fascinating the new places were.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Freedom and new adventures always have a way of washing away troubles. But when you're stuck, pain just festers in that cramped space.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: After seeing just how vast the sky can be, who'd still want to stay cooped up in some corner of DisCity?! Even if I have to be in the gutter, I'm always gonna look up at the sky.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: When you're in the sky's embrace, it catches you no matter what you become. It holds endless possibilities of my life!

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: And now that you're here with me, ${PlayerName}, it feels like we're both embracing this future full of endless possibilities.
Just as Zephyr touches down on the cross-shaped landing marker of the high-rise rooftop, the sun bursts through the clouds.
The city basks in the gentle sunlight, as if the rain and clouds from mere hours ago had never existed.
Zephyr leans on the railing, gazing at the distant horizon.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Finally went through. Chief, are you all right? Is Sinner Zephyr with you?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The signal is back to normal now, and the interference on the Bureau channels has cleared up.
The rare moment of tranquility between you is broken by the restored communications.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, we're both safe. There's been a misunderstanding . I'll submit a detailed report when I return.
You offer Nightingale a brief reassurance regarding the situation before ending the call. As you do so, you catch Zephyr gazing at you with a peculiar expression.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Cough...

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I won't put up a fight this time, if you need to arrest me as part of your job... Honestly, I thought I'd be surrounded by security forces the moment we touched down.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: If my first crash showed me a taste of freedom, then now I really get it—flying itself is my freedom!

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: I'm totally digging this answer about freedom, so I don't regret breaking the rules to make a run for it at all. Of course, I'll take it in stride if you have to slap the cuffs on me, Chief. That's your freedom, too.
Though Zephyr tries to make light of possibly being arrested again, her expression of grim resignation betrays her true feelings.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, are you going to break out again?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: ...Well, I can't really promise that. But Chief, I have to say—after today, I see you've got a pretty wild streak in you. It's making me believe that life at MBCC might not be as awful as I thought, and I think I'm finally moving on.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Surely you can be like the sky and embrace my occasional whims?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: But you never know what might happen, so at least let me keep the possibility of escape as a comforting thought, will you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just as I thought... still can't drop my guard.
With a sigh, you gesture for Zephyr to hold out her hand. Mirroring what she did at the bar, you gently trace a few words on her palm with your fingertip.
Zephyr looks bewildered by your sudden gesture, furrowing her brow as she tries to decipher your meaning. Then you pull out a neatly folded note from your pocket and place it in her palm.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Yes?
You gesture at her hand again, prompting Zephyr to open it in puzzlement.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Sinner Parole Permit?!
You close your eyes and dodge away for a moment before quickly heading for the stairs. Zephyr immediately catches up, chattering non-stop by your ear.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Hey—does this mean I don't have to stay at the Bureau every day anymore?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Technically, correct.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: While MBCC can't give you complete freedom or fulfill all your wishes, I'll do my best to advocate for Sinners within the bounds of regulation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But we need to set some ground rules. First, I know you don't like rules, but you must follow everything stated in the parole permit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Second, you need to maintain long-term cooperation and communication with MBCC, responding according to mission urgency.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Third, ensure your own safety when you're out, and contact MBCC immediately if there's an emergency.
As your words trail off, your eyes meet in a shared moment of silence.
Suddenly, Zephyr throws her arms around your neck. The force nearly makes you stumble as her joyous laughter fills your ears.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You got it! I'll hit you up ASAP if anything pops off! By the way, is it cool if I reach out even when everything's chill?
You steady her and let out a relieved sigh. Meeting her bright, hopeful eyes, you offer her a warm smile and a reassuring nod.
A few days later...
At three in the morning, the sound of knocking from your office window startles you. You open it and look around, only to find no one in sight.
When you return to your desk, you find a paper plane resting there. Unfolding it reveals Zephyr's unmistakable handwriting.
${PlayerName}, Prepping a fly later. Care to join?
